datasets.name: Lidar-DTM data (1 m x 1 m resolution)
datasets.source: Thuringian State Office for Soil Management and Geoinformation (TLUBN)
datasets.verbatim: Landslide mapping is based on lidar–DTM data with a 1 m × 1 m resolution provided by the Thuringian State Office for Soil Management and Geoinformation (TLUBN, 2019; Zangana et al., 2023a). ... The resulting data used in this research can be obtained from the first author upon reasonable request and are also publicly available at https://doi.org/10.22000/798 (Zangana et al., 2023a) and https://tlubn.thueringen.de/ (last access: 29 November 2025).

datasets.name: Landslide inventory map (reference map)
datasets.verbatim: A landslide inventory map (reference map) was created using manual on-screen mapping in ArcMap 10.7.

methods.name: GEOBIA-based landslide inventory mapping
methods.summary: A structured workflow using eCognition software that implements multi-resolution segmentation (MRS) and support vector machine (SVM) classification on lidar-derived land surface variables (LSVs). The method compares two models: one using default moving-window sizes and one using optimized window sizes for different landslide components (scarps and bodies), followed by a rule-based refinement stage.
methods.verbatim: We used the software eCognition 10.3 and developed a structured workflow to design a rule set for semi-automatic landslide mapping. ... The code used in this research is available from the first author upon reasonable request.

reproducibility_assessment: The lidar-DTM data is publicly available via the provided link, but the landslide inventory map is not linked or made available. The custom code used for the GEOBIA-based mapping is not provided in a repository or persistent link, being available only upon request.
